_about: Built by C:/MHGU-Extract/efx/export_weapon_effects.py. The weapon class's own motion-bound effects, per its .psl: `clips` is the game's schedule keyed "<motion set>:<motion number>" (draw = <cls>.psl, sa = <cls>_sa.psl), with each bit's record and the frame runs it is on. They run on the ROM-translated runtime taken from the Monster Viewer (docs/render/rom/effect/, see render/rom/SOURCE.json), driven by render/weapon-fx.js; `joints` are the joint numbers the effect's nodes bind to, supplied by the hunter's skeleton, and `record.payload` is the rProofEffectList record's 160 fixed bytes.
